prompt: Everything is realistic and photographic except the light itself, which is painted: every lamp, flame and glow is laid on in thick smeared strokes of pure colour, cadmium orange, rose and turquoise, bleeding into the air like wet paint, dreamlike. Faces stay realistic. Camera low at the height of the firebox, fresh banknotes scattered on the stone floor in the foreground. In a hidden 1920s basement print room, a huge cast-iron printing press throws sheets of banknotes into the air. Beside it a tall skinny man in a bowler hat with a heavy gold mayoral chain round his neck, a long narrow face, hollow cheeks and a pencil-thin grey moustache, shovels coal into the press's red-hot firebox, grinning. Behind him an exhausted stoker in a soot-black vest sits slumped against the brick wall. Riveted pipes, brass gauges, steam. Most of the frame is in deep shadow; the painted lights are the brightest things in it. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
